name: sgs/hero
title: SGS Hero
description: Page hero section with headline, sub-headline, CTAs, and background image.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: Wave 6 (2026-09-01). Migrates the split-media feature (image/video/SVG slot beside the text column) onto the shared media-atom system — NOT the section-level background (bgVideo/bgParallax/bgKenBurns/backgroundOverlay*), which stays on SGS_Container_Wrapper. THREE prefixes, not one, because hero's own legacy naming used three different conventions for one physical element and none may be renamed (D338): 'split' reproduces splitImage*/splitVideo*/splitMediaType* exactly (source + media-type bases); 'splitMedia' reproduces splitMediaObjectFit/splitMediaObjectPosition* exactly (object-fit + focal-point bases); 'media' reproduces mediaOverlayColour/mediaOverlayGradient/mediaParallax/mediaKenBurns/mediaAnimationDuration exactly (overlay + motion bases). The source atom's picker writes a NEW {base}Id/{base}Url pair (its own canonical shape) rather than hero's legacy composite {id,url,alt} object. NO read-time fallback to the legacy object — Bean-locked (2026-09-02): R-31-14 bans exactly that shape, and this block already carries a 2026-08-13 precedent of deleting an identically-shaped bridge for the same reason. An already-published hero instance holding only the legacy splitImage/splitVideo/splitSvg shape renders an EMPTY split-media slot until re-uploaded through the new picker (see render.php's own comment at the split-media source resolution). The legacy attributes stay declared (never renamed — D338), simply unread/unwritten going forward.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note_animation: FR-35-6 — anim:parallax/anim:duration resolve via bgParallax/bgAnimationDuration (explicit attrMap; no `prefix` declared, per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). bgKenBurns is a separate preset toggle with no animation-cluster member and stays unmapped. anim:preset/anim:easing/anim:stagger/anim:trigger are honest gaps — no sgsAnimation*/staggerDelay/scroll-trigger attrs on this block. D701 (2026-08-20): `borderColourGradient` (resting) added as the base-level sibling to `borderColourHoverGradient` — the wrapper's resting border colour comes from WP-native `__experimentalBorder.color` (already mapped above at `css:border-color`), and this new gradient wins over that native solid colour at render time when set (mirrors `borderColourHover`/`borderColourHoverGradient` and `sgs/quote`'s `borderColour`/`borderColourGradient` pair). See render.php for the emission order that makes the override work without `!important`. D702 (2026-08-20): `css:background-color`/`css:color` retargeted from the dead `native:color.background` reference (WordPress never registered that attribute — `supports.color` was absent) to the plain `backgroundColour`/`textColour` string attrs, mirroring `sgs/testimonial-slider`'s `slider` element. The hover pair (`backgroundColourHover`/`textColourHover`) was already declared on this block but bound to nothing until now.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: The content/media split grid (named regions content + media; the `supports.sgs.gridAreas` flag that used to name them was deleted D639 — the regions are defined by the contentPadding/mediaPadding attrs themselves). Declares no `prefix` so arrangement members map explicitly. No `display`, `align-items`, `order` or `overflow` attribute exists on this block — honest GAPs, not omissions.

content-band.label: Content band
content-band._note: Mirrors sgs/container's content-band — the content-width constraining band, independent of the `content` grid-area below. Padding resolves via the default {prefix}{Suffix} convention (contentBandPadding).

content.label: Content column
content._note: The `content` grid-area (headline/sub-headline/CTA column in the split variant). background-color and padding both resolve via the default convention (contentBackground, contentPadding). css:background-image is explicitly attrMapped to contentBackgroundGradient because the default {prefix}{suffix} convention has no 'BackgroundGradient' candidate (only 'BackgroundImage'/'Overlay*' suffixes exist for this member) — found live 2026-08-15 during element-manifest-drift triage. REPOINTED 2026-08-16 (D643): this mapped `contentBackgroundGradientFrom`, an attribute deleted by the D636 storage collapse (837f7c97) — the manifest had been claiming a non-existent attr. The accepted-orphan note about a `...To` sibling is gone with it: one string attr now holds the whole gradient, so there is no second colour stop to strand.

media.label: Media column
media._note: The `media` grid-area. Most box/border members resolve via the default `image{Suffix}` convention (splitMediaBorderWidth/Style/Colour/Radius/Padding). `mediaBackground` (a second, plainer background attr alongside `mediaBackgroundColour`) is a genuine ORPHAN — two overlapping attrs for one concept, not modelled here. `anim:parallax`/`anim:duration` (added 2026-08-13, mirrors the wrapper element's own bgParallax/bgAnimationDuration mapping) resolve via mediaParallax/mediaAnimationDuration — a SEPARATE motion control family from the section's own bgParallax/bgKenBurns, scoped to the foreground split-media element, not the section background. mediaKenBurns is a preset toggle with no animation-cluster member and stays unmapped, same treatment as bgKenBurns on the wrapper.

headline.label: Headline
headline._note: block.json `selectors.typography.root` scopes the wrapper's native typography support to `.sgs-hero__headline`, so these native paths are this element's controls, not the wrapper's. `headlineMarginBottom` (the standalone parent-side spacing override) was RETIRED 2026-08-12 (Spec 35 Phase 2.3, Bean-confirmed dead — its live values were scratch-page defaults, not deliberate client settings) — no layout member remains on this element.

sub-headline.label: Sub-headline
sub-headline._note: No dedicated typography attrs — inherits the wrapper's native typography. `subHeadlineMaxWidth`/`subHeadlineMarginBottom` were RETIRED 2026-08-12 (Spec 35 Phase 2.3, same as headlineMarginBottom above) — nothing layout-shaped remains on this element.

cta.label: CTA buttons
cta._note: CTAs render via InnerBlocks (sgs/multi-button > sgs/button children, FR-22-6) — no scalar cta* content/style attrs remain on this block, so nothing to cluster-map here.

overlay.label: Overlay
overlay._note: The decorative dimming overlay layered over the section background (`.sgs-hero__overlay`, a sibling <span> — render.php ~line 992-1000). Distinct from the wrapper's own background and from the split-media's own media-overlay below. REPOINTED 2026-08-16 (D643): this mapped `overlayGradientFrom`, deleted by the D636 storage collapse (837f7c97); `overlayGradient` now holds the complete CSS gradient string, so the old note about Angle/To being honest gaps no longer applies — there are no sibling scalars left to strand. `clusters: []` (revised 2026-08-15, first draft declared 'fill' and that recreated 15 CONTESTED findings against `wrapper`, which ALSO reaches the same bare fill-cluster members with no prefix — clusters=[] plus the explicit attrMap above still claims the two mapped attrs cleanly via placement-reach's TIER-1/authoritative path, with zero collision risk from the unmapped fill members). `prefix: ""` opts this element out of orphan-candidate scanning. Found live 2026-08-15: DB tagged 4 attrs css_element='overlay', undeclared until now.

media-overlay.label: Media overlay
media-overlay._note: A second decorative overlay layered on top of the split-media column only (`.sgs-hero__media-overlay`, render.php ~line 1170) — separate from the section-level `overlay` element above; mirrors its shape 1:1 but scoped to the foreground media instead of the section background. REPOINTED 2026-08-16 (D643): this mapped `mediaOverlayGradientFrom`, deleted by the D636 storage collapse (837f7c97); same one-string shape and same removal of the stranded-sibling note as `overlay` above. `clusters: []`, same CONTESTED-avoidance rationale as `overlay` above. `prefix: ""` opt-out, same rationale. Found live 2026-08-15: DB tagged 4 attrs css_element='media-overlay', undeclared until now.

split-image.label: Split image
split-image._note: The IMAGE type's extra class, applied by sgs_tier_media_render()'s per-type $extra argument so it lands ONLY on an tier. It intentionally carries NO attrMap: as of 2026-08-27 (commit 33816708e) every splitMedia* control paints on the type-agnostic `.sgs-hero__split-media` base class instead, so video and SVG tiers obey the same controls — they previously obeyed none. The class is still emitted and still load-bearing for STATIC, image-only styling in style.css: the base width/height/object-fit/display rule (style.css:292) and the hover-zoom transform (style.css:305-318). Neither is attribute-driven, so neither belongs to an attr and neither maps here.

split-media.label: Split media
split-media._note: The type-agnostic base class emitted by sgs_tier_media_render() — carries `sgs-hero__split-media` plus `--{tier}` and `--{type}` modifiers on EVERY tier node whatever its type. It OWNS the whole splitMedia* control family as of 2026-08-27 (commit 33816708e): width, height, border-radius, border-color/style/width, padding, object-fit and object-position all emit scoped to this class in render.php, which is what lets a video or SVG tier honour them. object-fit/object-position emit on the compound `.sgs-hero__split-media--image,.sgs-hero__split-media--video` selector — replaced-element properties do nothing on the <span> wrapping inline SVG — and a BEM MODIFIER is never an element, so the classifier's deriver cuts at the `--` and still resolves here. ⛔ WHY THIS MAP MOVED: it lived on split-image, which pinned 16 block_attributes.css_element rows to a class those properties no longer paint on. The tier variants (splitMediaPaddingTablet, splitMediaObjectPositionMobile, …) were already correct because they carry no attrMap key and fall through to selector derivation — that split is what exposed the stale manifest. `css:max-width` added 2026-09-05 (db-consistency residual close-out): render.php:781-797 shows TWO attrs genuinely paint max-width here — `splitMediaMaxWidth` (object + `splitMediaMaxWidthUnit` sibling, desktop-tier only) and `splitMediaMaxWidthPercent` (bare number, emitted SECOND so it wins the cascade when an operator sets both). `splitMediaMaxWidth` is declared the routing owner because the object+unit pair is strictly MORE expressive — it can express a percentage via `splitMediaMaxWidthUnit: '%'`, so nothing is lost. `splitMediaMaxWidthPercent` remains a working, independent editor control; it simply stops being a clone-routing target for this css_property/element pair.

_selectorsNote: S1 fix (2026-09-02, uniformity sweep, inspector-scan rule 33): selectors.typography retargeted from '.sgs-hero__headline' to the block root ('.wp-block-sgs-hero', matching cta-section/info-box/notice-banner). '.sgs-hero__headline' is set ONLY as an InnerBlocks TEMPLATE child's className in edit.js, never emitted by hero's own rendered markup — the old selector generated a scoped rule at CSS specificity (0,2,0) that could never beat the child block's own inline typography at (1,0,0,0), so hero's 7 declared native typography controls were silent no-ops (Spec 35 F.1).

attributes._comment_sourceAtomPair: Wave 6 (2026-09-01) — the `source` atom's own canonical shape (prefix 'split'), written by HeroSplitMediaPanelLayout's new picker. Hand-declared here (rather than left to the mediaElements auto-injection filter alone) because render.php/edit.js destructure these as literal variables to resolve the split-media source (no legacy fallback — see the mediaElements comment above) — check-undeclared-attrs.py flags any literal destructure of an attribute block.json doesn't declare, regardless of whether a runtime filter would also inject it. The legacy `splitImageTablet`/`splitVideo`/`splitVideoTablet`/`splitVideoMobile`/`splitSvg`/`splitSvgTablet`/`splitSvgMobile` attributes these replace were REMOVED (not just retired) 2026-09-02 — Bean-locked (R-31-14 strict reading): with no read-time fallback, nothing on either the render or editor side consumed them any more, so they were genuinely dead declarations, not merely superseded ones. `variants.split` above was updated to `splitImageUrl`/`splitImageUrlMobile` (the new discriminating names) in the same commit. `splitImage`/`splitImageMobile` (the two composite object attrs previously declared here) were kept alive for one extra day purely because `scripts/dbschema/check_value_identity.py` anchored the cloning pipeline's scalar-media role assignment on their literal names — see `scripts/data/scalar-media-roles.json`'s `__RE_ANCHOR_2026_09_02` note. That anchor moved onto `splitMediaType` the following day (Wave 7b, same date), which IS genuinely read by render.php to select the media family, closing the last reason these two dead declarations needed to survive — they are deleted in the same commit as the re-anchor, and `check_value_identity.py`'s assertions were repointed at `splitMediaType` alongside them.

splitMediaDecorative.description: WCAG 2.1 AA 1.1.1 (finding 18, 2026-09-02). When true, the split-media element (image/video/svg — the only real /

backgroundColour.description: Resting (non-hover) root background colour, bound to the wrapper element's css:background-color (D702). Distinct from the decorative backgroundOverlayColour/overlayGradient dimming layer.

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting root background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColour at render time (mirrors the borderColour/borderColourGradient pair).

backgroundColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover root background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColourHover at render time.

textColour.description: Resting (non-hover) root text colour, bound to the wrapper element's css:color (D702).

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting root text colour (background-clip: text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over textColour at render time.

textColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover root text colour (background-clip: text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over textColourHover at render time.

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColourHover at render time (D636).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting (non-hover) border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the WP-native __experimentalBorder.color at render time (D701).

splitMediaBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the split-image border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over splitMediaBorderColour at render time (D636).

attributes._comment_boxShapeNewBases: C19 item 3 (2026-09-04) — the box-shape atom's remaining bases (Wave 6 only adopted object-fit/focal-point). Hand-declared, not left to auto-injection, because render.php/edit.js destructure them as literal variables (same precedent as the 'source atom pair' comment above). Mirrors sgs/media's own shapes exactly: MediaSizing carries no default (a 'default':null on a typed attr 400s SSR previews); Shape/AspectRatio/MinHeight/MaxWidth/MaxHeight match box-shape.js's MEDIA_ATTR_TYPES map. MaxWidthPercent has no default, same as every other non-tiered number base in the atom.

padding.description: Base (desktop) padding, owned outright — hero declares NO supports.spacing, so before 2026-08-21 this control wrote to style.spacing and WordPress DISCARDED it on save (D338/D587 class). Matches the D555/D707 container shape.
